sourceReason: The endpoint is the unnumbered consequence of Maslova’s theorem in §5, p. 13 of arXiv:2609.00419v1. The translation represents degrees by their equivalence classes as in §2 and instantiates the computable-enumerability prerequisite with the encoding of each natural number n as n false bits.
